Account wallet :.description:
> Hide or show wallet balance next to username. 

 - Hide : Hide the account wallet. 
 - Show : Show the account wallet.

Avatar status border :.description:
> Hide or reduce the player avatar status border on the top bar in the user block. 

 - Default : Minimal default. 
 - Reduce : Reduce size on mouseover. 
 - User color : User color border. 
 - Hide : Hide status border.

Bigger notification button :.description:
> Make the notification icon bigger. 

 - No : Default Steam size for notification button. 
 - Yes : Larger size for notification button.

Compact avatar :.description:
> Make the avatar block compact. 

 - Default : Default Steam user avatar bloc. 
 - Compact : The block expands when the mouse moves over it.

Animated hovering :.description:
> Trigger an animation when hovering over contacts in the friends list. 

 - No : No animation when mouseover. 
 - Yes : Slide text to the right on mouseover.

Avatar size :.description:
> Choice the size of the user avatar on friends list. 

 - Default : Medium avatar size. 
 - Small : Small avatar size. 
 - Large : Large avatar size (display issues may occur with this size depending on the length and description of the game being launched as well as the size of the friends list window).

Font size :.description:
> Change the size of the font of the friends list (not applied on compact mod). 

 - Default : Steam default font size. 
 - Smaller : Small font size.

Friends conversation tabs header glow :.description:
> Enable this option to remove the glow behind tab in conversations. 

 - Default : Yellow glow + yellow dot. 
 - User color : User color glow + user color dot 
 - Hide #1 : Remove glow and show only yellow dot. 
 - Hide #2 : Remove glow and show only user color dot.

Friends list header glow :.description:
> Enable this option to remove the glow behind the profile picture on the friends list. 

 - No : Leave the glow effect. 
 - Yes : Delete the glow effect.

Group chats position :.description:
> Modify the position of the groups chats. 

 - Default : Steam vanilla position. 
 - Top : Top position. 
 - Hide : Hide bloc.

Hide footer :.description:
> Hide footer on friends list. 

 - No : No modification. 
 - Yes : Hide bottom black bar.

Hide footer (fix) :.description:
> Enable this option if you have chosen to hide the footer to fix the icon for creating a chat group. 

 - No : Are you crazy ? 
 - Yes : An animation is put in place for a better visual experience.

Hide voice chat :.description:
> Hide the voice chat icon in conversations. 

 - No : Hide the voice chat button in friends conversations. 
 - Yes : Shows the voice chat button in friends conversations.

Inverted contact bloc :.description:
> Enabling this option reverses the display of the contact list. 

 - No : Default ; The avatars are on the left, the text is on the right. 
 - Yes : The avatars are on the right, the text is on the left.

Offline friends :.description:
> Hide offline friends in friends list. 

 - Show : Display the 'offline friends' section in the contact list. 
 - Hide : Does not display the 'offline friends' section in the contact list (these are still findable via search).

Alternative view for back to top button.description:
> Change the appearance and display of the back to top button when scrolling the game page. 

 - No : Default view. 
 - Yes : Alternative view.

Alternative view for scrolling bloc :.description:
> Change the appearance and display of the top game panel when scrolling the game page. 

 - No : Default bloc. 
 - Yes : Alternative view.

Bigger gamepage/library buttons :.description:
> Enlarge the play/download buttons on the library and gamepage. 

 - No : Minimal default size buttons (medium). 
 - Yes : Bigger size buttons (large).

Bigger header :.description:
> Enabling this option makes the image at the top of the game page larger (total image size) 

 - Default : Default size. 
 - Full image : Bigger size.

Blurred background :.description:
> Blur the background of the game page. 

 - Full Dark : Applies dark color (#121212) to the entire page of a game. 
 - Blurred : The top of the page will be blurred.

Community content :.description:
> Hide or show the community content in gamepage. 

 - Hide : Hide community content in gamepage (better performance if you have a bad pc). 
 - Show : Show community content in gamepage.

Dropdown stream/play button :.description:
> Show or hide the dropdown menu button on the play/install button on the game page. 

 - No : Hide the dropdown menu button on the play/install button. 
 - Yes : Show the dropdown menu button on the play/install button.

Gamepage/library buttons svg color (Play.description:
> Set the svg color of the library buttons. 

 - White : Applies white color on play/install buttons. 
 - Same as the outline : The color will be the same as the outline of the button.

Header (compact mod) :.description:
> Hide or show the header image at the top of the game page to save more space. 

 - Show : Show the header image at the top of the game page. 
 - Hide : Hide the header image at the top of the game page to save more space.

Header size adjustment :.description:
> Enabling this option will make the game page headers stretched. 

 - No : Vanilla size, no image modifications. 
 - Yes : The image fills the entire header block.

Hide 'post-party summary' / 'WYRTG ?' :.description:
> Hide or show 'post-party summary' or 'Would you recommend this game ?' in game gampeage. 

 - Show all : Show all elements. 
 - Hide all : Hide all elements. 
 - Show summary only : Show only 'post-party summary', 'Would you recommend this game ?' is not displayed. 
 - Show 'Would you recommend this game ?' only : Show only 'Would you recommend this game ?', 'post-party summary' is not displayed.

Inverted gamepage (known bugs) :.description:
> Invert gamepage blocks (community content option set to 'Show' not work with this option). 

 - Default : The layout is the same as the default steam skin. 
 - Inverted : The layout is reversed from the vanilla Steam skin (bugs may appear with this option selected).

Hide all activities :.description:
> Enabling this option hides all games activities (updates, personal trophies earned, and those of contacts). 

 - Show all activities : Show all activities. 
 - Show all activities on mouseover : Show all activities on mouseover only. 
 - Hide all activities : Hide all activities. 
 - Hide only the no activities message : Hide only 'There's no recent activity from the developers of this title or from your friends'.

Text on play/download button :.description:
> Show or hide the text of the play/download buttons. 

 - No : No text will be displayed, only the button icon will be present. 
 - Yes : Text will be displayed next to the icon (play, stop, download).

Alternative topbar color :.description:
> Modify the color of the topbar. 

 - Dark : Full dark topbar 
 - Grey : Full grey topbar 
 - Grey/dark : Grey topbar and dark buttons.

Alternative ui color for context menus/m.description:
> Inverted color for context menus/menus. 

 - No : Default color 
 - Yes : Inverted color

Avatar frame :.description:
> Hide or show avatar frame on all avatars. 

 - Hide : Hide avatar frame on the entire skin. 
 - Show : Show avatar frame on the entire skin. 

 NOTE : If you decide to display avatar frames, remember to check the toggle in the Steam settings 'Contacts and Chats: Enable animated avatars and avatar frames in your contacts list and in chat'

Compact menus/context menus :.description:
> This option allows you to make the menus/context menus compact (or not), animated (or not), with a left border (or not). 

 - The informations are directly on the sub-options.

Corners radius :.description:
> Sets the strength of corner rounding. 

 - Square : 0px. 
 - Rounded : 5px. 
 - More rounded : 10px.

Hover borders on library and webkit bloc.description:
> Make the hover borders of library/webkit items full and no longer just on the bottom. 

 - Full borders : Applies the user's color to all borders on mouseover. 
 - Bottom only : Applies the user's color only to the bottom border on mouseover.

Resize grip (Steam windows) :.description:
> Show or hide the resizing grip display. 

 - Default : Default Steam grip. 
 - Default (smaller) : Smaller default Steam grip. 
 - Alternative UI : Alternative UI for the resize grip. 
 - Alternative UI (smaller) : Smaller alternative UI for the resize grip. 
 - Hide : Hide the resize grip. 

 NOTE : If you select 'Hide', you will need to disable the friends option 'Hide footer (fix)'

Steam bigpicture button :.description:
> Hide or show Steam bigpicture button in top bar. 

 - Hide : Hide topbar Steam bigpicture button. 
 - Show : Show topbar Steam bigpicture button.

Steam news button :.description:
> Hide or show Steam news button in top bar. 

 - Hide : Hide topbar Steam news button. 
 - Show : Show topbar Steam news button.

Title area buttons :.description:
> Make the title bar buttons bigger (close/maximize/minimize buttons). 

 - Small : Small titlebar buttons. 
 - Enlarged (w11 users) : Enlarged buttons for Windows 11 users. 
 - Enlarged (w10 users) : Enlarged buttons for Windows 10 users.

Vanilla topbar style :.description:
> Set the topbar in the vanilla style of steam skin. 

 - Minimal Dark : Topbar buttons are on the same line. 
 - Vanilla topbar : Set Topbar as on vanilla skin, buttons are on two lines.

Alternative library navigation button :.description:
> Changes the appearance of the navigation arrows on the library shelves. 

 - Default : Just arrows displayed. 
 - Alternative : Arrows and grey borders.

Alternative games names hover effect :.description:
> Change the appearance of the game name hover in the What's New block. 

 - Default : Left user color border on mouseover. 
 - Alt #1 : Bottom user color border on mouseover. 
 - Alt #2 : Full user color border on mouseover.

Alternate view of in-game friends :.description:
> Changes the appearance and layout of in-game friend icons in library. 

 - Default : Defaut appearence. 
 - Alternative : Under the game block.

Animated buttons hovering :.description:
> Add an animation on the play/install/stop buttons on hovering in the library (gamepage buttons effect included). 

 - No : No hover effect. 
 - Animated : Enable hover effect on hovering buttons.

Compact collections :.description:
> Make collections display compact. 

 - No : Spacing between Steam games covers by default. 
 - Yes : Smaller spacing between games covers.

Compact filters :.description:
> Make the library filters block compact. 

 - No : Default Steam filters spacing. 
 - Yes : Compact filters spacing.

Compact labels (library + whats news) :.description:
> Make Hide Today, Yesterday, Last Week blocs from library and what's new compact. 

 - Default : The labels are not glued to the border. 
 - Compact : The labels are glued to the border. 
 - Compact (bottom) : The labels are glued to the border at the bottom (library only).

Compact library :.description:
> Make library display compact. 

 - No : Spacing between Steam games covers by default. 
 - Yes : Smaller spacing between games covers.

Compact mod :.description:
Removes the filter & search from the sidebar to save even more space. 

 - Default : Display filter and search. 
 - Compact : Hide filter only. 
 - Ultra compact : Hide filter and search.

Compact news container :.description:
> Make the news container compact. 

 - Steam default : Vanilla Steam size. 
 - Compact #1 : Small size with small fonts. 
 - Compact #2 : Small size with normal font. 
 - Ultra compact : Displays only the text of the news, also allows more news to be displayed. 
 - Ultra compact (center content) : Same as ultra compact, but with centered elements.

Download icon on uninstalled games :.description:
> Show or hide the download icon on uninstalled games in the library. 

 - Show : Show the download icon on uninstalled games in the library. 
 - Hide : Hide the download icon on uninstalled games in the library.

Hide shelf :.description:
> Hide the add shelf button in the library. 

 - No : Show the add shelf button in the library 
 - Yes : Hide the add shelf button in the library.

Labels color for completed games :.description:
> Define the appearance of labels for games that are 100% completed in the library. 

 - Minimal : Blurred background, user color text, no medal (no modifications). 
 - Others choices : User color background, white text with medal. 

 NOTE: Choose the sub-option based on what you have chosen for the Compact labels option.

Library labels :.description:
> Hide 'Today, Yesterday, Last Week' from library. 

 - Show : Show labels on library and news bloc. 
 - Hide library only : Hide labels on library only. 
 - Hide What's new only : Hide labels on What's new only. 
 - Hide all : Hide labels on library and news bloc.

Library games hover glow color :.description:
> Change the color of the glow when you hover over a game image in your library. 

 - Default : White glow. 
 - User color : User color glow.

News container :.description:
> Hide or show 'What's New' bloc in the library. 

 - Hide : Hide 'What's New' bloc. 
 - Show : Show 'What's New' bloc.

Static hovering (paysage games of Recent.description:
> Make paysage games mouse hover static. 

 - Animated : Animated on mouse hover. 
 - Static : Static on mouse hover.

Static hovering (portrait games of Libra.description:
> Make portrait games mouse hover static. 

 - Animated : Animated on mouse hover. 
 - Static : Static on mouse hover.

Miniprofile background :.description:
> Show or hide image/video on background by default on mini profiles. 

 - Hide : Set the mini-profile background black with an acrylic effect. 
 - Show : The mini-profile background image will be displayed.

Hours played :.description:
> Hide the block of hours played on the miniprofiles. 

 - Show : Displays hours played on players mini-profiles. 
 - Hide : Hide hours played on players mini-profiles.

No button labels in list mod :.description:
> hide button names to only have the icon when the overlay is in list mode only. 

 - No : Hide buttons labels. 
 - Yes : Show buttons labels.

No button labels in normal mod :.description:
> hide button names to only have the icon when the overlay is in normal mode only. 

 - No : Hide buttons labels. 
 - Yes : Show buttons labels.

Bigger buttons :.description:
> Make the overlay buttons bigger. 

 - No : Default size buttons. 
 - Yes : Bigger size buttons.

Alternative color update :.description:
> Choose the color of games update notifications in the sidebar. 
 - Default : Green 
 - User color : User color.

Alternative hover effect :.description:
> Set user color gradient to the left on hover. 

 - Default : Left user color border on mouseover. 
 - User color gradient : Left user color border and gradient on mouseover.

Alternative ingame friends indicator :.description:
> Changes the indicator of ingame friends. 

 - Minimal Dark default : Vertical bar. 
 - Minimal Dark alternative #1 : Alternative vertical bar. 
 - Minimal Dark alternative #2 : Horizontal bar. 
 - Dot #1 : Rounded dot. 
 - Dot #2 : Small rounded dot. 
 - Dot #3 : Squared dot. 
 - Dot #4 : Small squared dot.

Animated mouseover :.description:
> Add an animation when hovering over the list of games. 

 - No : No animation. 
 - Yes : Animated.

Bigger font size :.description:
> Make games names bigger. 

 - No : Normal font size. 
 - Yes : Bigger font size.

Bolder names :.description:
> Make the game names in the sidebar bolder. 

 - No : Normal font. 
 - Yes : Bolder font.

Games names overflow :.description:
> Enable this option to prevent the game name from overlapping outside the sidebar block. 

 - No : The game name overflows and is displayed in full. 
 - Yes : The game name no longer overflows the sidebar when the mouse hovers over it.

Installed/selected games color :.description:
> Changes the color of installed/selected games. 

 - Minimal Dark : Beige names / user color selected. 
 - Minimal Dark alternative : White names / user color selected. 
 - White : White names / white selected.

No left images :.description:
> Hide game images to the left of the names in the left bar. 

 - No : Show images. 
 - Yes : Hide images.

Persistent Sidebar :.description:
> Enabling this option displays the sidebar where it is not usually displayed (webkit, community, profil). 

 - No : Hide sidebar on webkit, community and profil. 
 - Yes : Show sidebar on webkit, community and profil. 

 Known bug : the main filter is not accessible on the webkit.

Pointer fix :.description:
> Fix cursor for sidebar resize when the Persistent Sidebar option is disabled only. 

 - No : Leave this option disabled if you are using the persistent sidebar. 
 - Yes : Enable this option if you do not use the persistent sidebar.

Resize width :.description:
> Choose to set a fixed length for the sidebar or if you want to expand it manually. 

 - Fixed position : Fixed sidebar (resizing are not possible) 
 - Manual resize : Enlarge the sidebar manually. 

 NOTE : Not compatible with persistent sidebar option.

Right Sidebar :.description:
> Place the left bar on the right of the Steam client. 

 - Left : Left sidebar. 
 - Right sidebar (to enlarge the sidebar you will always have to slide to the right and not to the left).

Show sidebar on mouseover :.description:
> Displays the sidebar when the mouse hovers over it. 

 - Default : Default display for sidebar. 
 - On mouseover : Displays the sidebar when the mouse hovers over it. 

 Note : The advanced filters and the filter buttons are not working.

Uninstalled selected games color :.description:
> Changes the color of selected uninstalled games. 

 - Minimal Dark : Red color. 
 - White : White color. 
 - User : User color.

Alignment fix for 4K resolution :.description:
> Enabling this option will fix the top bar alignment for 4K resolutions. 

 - No : No fix. 
 - Yes : Applied fix.

Alternative contacts icon :.description:
> Use alternative icon for contacts bloc. 

 - Minimal Dark #1 (fill) : Rounded icon with fill effect. 
 - Minimal Dark #1 (outline) : Rounded icon with outline effect. 
 - Minimal Dark #2 (fill) : Phone icon with fill effect. 
 - Minimal Dark #2 (outline) : Phone icon with outline effect. 
 - Minimal Dark #3 (fill) : Chat bubble with fill effect. 
 - Minimal Dark #3 (outline) : Chat bubble with outline effect.

Alternative downloads UI :.description:
> Change the appearance of the download block. 

 - New UI : Set download button compact. 
 - New UI (alt) : Compact button, but thinner line. 
 - Vanilla rework : Vanilla ui with Minimal vibes. 
 - Vanilla rework (text only) : Vanilla ui but only text 
 - Minimal Dark : Default UI.

Downloads progress bar color :.description:
> Enable this option to make another color for the progress download bar. 

 - No : Green progress bar. 
 - Yes : User color progress bar.

Hover/active borders :.description:
> Enable this option to make the hover effect on top bar elements display a complete border (also on active). 

 - No : Top borders only. 
 - Yes : Full borders.

Hide topbar elements :.description:
> Hide topbar menus or arrows. 

 - Show all : Display all elements of the topbar. 
 - Hide menus only : Hide only menus. 
 - Hide arrows only : Hide only arrows. 
 - Hide all : Hide arrows, menus and tabs.

Hide topbar tabs :.description:
> Hide topbar tabs. 

 - Show all : Display all tabs. 
 - Hide w&c : Hide webkit and community tabs.

Longer tabs :.description:
> Make the topbar tabs longer. 

 - No : Normal width. 
 - Yes : Longer tabs.

Root menu Steam text :.description:
> Hide or show steam text in top left of the root menu. 

 - Hide : Hide root menu Steam text. 
 - Show : Display root menu Steam text.

Tabs text transform :.description:
> Set capitalize text to topbar tabs. 

 - No : Lowercase tab text. 
 - Yes : Capitalize tab text.

Topbar icons menu hover effect :.description:
> Use alternative hover effect for icons menu (display, contacts, games, support). 

 - Fill : Fill effect on mouseover. 
 - Outline : Outline effect on mouseover.

Topbar Store tab left icon (currency ico.description:
> Changes the currency logo on the store icon. 

 - No icon : Hide Store tabs icon. 
 - Fill icon (euro) : Fill euro icon. 
 - Oultine icon (euro) : Outline euro icon. 
 - Fill icon (dollar) : Fill dollar icon. 
 - Oultine icon (dollar) : Outline dollar icon. 
 - Fill icon (pound sterling) : Fill pound sterling icon. 
 - Oultine icon (pound sterling) : Outline pound sterling icon.

Topbar tabs left icons (hover effect inc.description:
> Adds an icon to the left of the top bar tabs text. 

 - No icons (text only) : Hide icons and show just text tabs. 
 - Icons active (fill + text) : Show icons and text tabs with fill effect. 
 - Icons active (outline + text) : Show icons and text tabs with outline effect.

Topbar tabs left icons, no text :.description:
> Enable this option if you want to have just icons and no text. 

 - No : Show tabs text and icons. 
 - Yes : Hide tabs text, show just icons.

Alternative root menu icon :.description:
> Change the root menu icon with a alternative icon. 

 - Minimal Dark : Half Steam logo. 
 - Minimal Dark #1 : Full Steam logo. 
 - Minimal Dark #2 : Rounded Steam logo (fill). 
 - Minimal Dark #3 : Rounded Steam logo (oultine). 
 - Minimal Dark #4 : Squared Steam logo (fill). 
 - Minimal Dark #5 : Squared Steam logo (oultine).

Change UI font :.description:
> Change the font of the interface. 

 - Known bugs with topbar option 'Root menu Steam text' is disabled.

Default pointers :.description:
> Display or hide pointers by default on the entire skin. 

 - Steam : Steam default pointers. 
 - Minimal Dark : Same cursor on the entire skin.

Hide scrollbars :.description:
> Hide or show scrollbars. 

 - Hide : Hide all scrollbars on the entirety of the skin. 
 - Show : Show all scrollbars on the entirety of the skin.

Mouseover animation of settings menu tab.description:
> Enable or disable the category hover effect in settings section. 

 - Animated : Mouseover are animated. 
 - Static : Mousesover are static.

No titlebar (Linux) :.description:
> Enable this option if you are using a tiled window manager in Linux and only use keyboard shortcuts to manage windows. 

 - No : For Windows users. 
 - Yes : If you are using a tiled window manager in Linux. 

 Note : Leave this option disabled if you are on Windows.

Pure black color (OLED) :.description:
> Activate this option to enable pure black if you have an OLED screen. 

 - No : Default color. 
 - Yes : Pure black (oled)

Windows corners fix :.description:
> Same border radius value on all topbar buttons. 

 No : Default values. 
 Yes : Same values. 

 NOTE : If you enable this option, you will need to disable the option directly below it, 'Windows 10 fix for root close corner'.

Windows 10 fix corners :.description:
> Fix the top left corner & top right corner for Windows 10 users. 

 NOTE : Disable this option if you enable the option directly above, 'Windows corners fix'.

Alternative UI for new Steam menu :.description:
> The new Steam store menu has arrived, enabling this option will offer an alternative UI. 

 - Minimal new UI : Minimal new Steam menu without modifications. 
 - Minimal new UI (buttons) : Minimal new UI (buttons). 
 - Compact : Minimal new Steam menu compact. 
 - Ultra compact : Minimal new Steam menu ultra compact (just an icon & default size). 
 - Ultra compact #1 : Minimal new Steam menu ultra compact (just an icon & compact size).

Blocs backgrounds :.description:
> This option changes the background shots of news or game update blocks to blurry or not. 

 - Full dark : Full background, without transparency. 
 - Blurred : The backgrounds are blurred.

Carousel arrows borders :.description:
> Show or hide borders on carousel arrows on the main webkit page and for all other parts using them. 

 - No : Hide carousel arrows borders. 
 - yes : Show carousel arrows borders.

Compact Webkit :.description:
> Hide the left sidebar on the webkit homepage. 

 - Hide : Hide left sidebar on homepage. 
 - Show : Show left sidebar webkit.

Events header :.description:
> Show or remove the events wallpaper on the webkit homepage. 

 - Minimal Dark : Event wallpaper are displayed. 
 - Hide : Events header are hidden.

Events background :.description:
> Display or hide the custom Steam image for events on the webkit. 

 - Default background : Default event wallpaper. 
 - Black background : Hide event wallpaper and replace it with dark color.

Hide '+ Add a Showcase' :.description:
> Hide '+ Add a Showcase' on your Steam profile. 

 - No : Show '+ Add a showcase' on your Steam profile. 
 - Yes : Hide '+ Add a showcase' on your Steam profile. 

 > If you enable this option, you will no longer be able to add a new showcase to your Steam profile (unless you disable the option).

Hide footers :.description:
> Hide Steam information on webkit footers. 

 - Hide : Hide legal informations at the bottom page of browser. 
 - Show : Show legal informations at the bottom page of browser.

Hide VAC ban information on profiles :.description:
> Hide VAC ban information on users profiles. 

 - Yes : Hide VAC ban information on profiles. 
 - No : Show VAC ban information on profiles.

Profiles :.description:
> Enabling this option makes the profile page blocks full and removes the blur effect. 

 - Minimal Dark : Blurred blocs. 
 - No blur blocs : Solid black color blocs.

Profiles headers :.description: > If you are using profile skin (or not), enable this option to view the color of the predefined block headers in the profile you applied (also displays on the profiles you view).

Solid background color profiles :.description:
> Make the background of profiles on WebKit dark. 

 - Default : No changes, video and image visible. 
 - Solid color : Dark and solid color, no video, no image.

URL bar :.description:
> This option allows you to permanently hide the URL bar or display it only on hover. 

 - Visible : Steam default. 
 - Hide : Hide the url bar. 
 - Only show on hover : Show the url bar only on mouseover.

Wishlist new Steam menu :.description:
> The new Steam webkit menu is hidden by default on the wishlist. Enable this option to show it again. 

 - Hide default menu : Hide menu in wishlist. 
 - Revisited menu : Shows only the search and cart/wishlist buttons.
